and the river of Egypt, Josh 15:4 .

13.heading: my master:
refs: Though they had booty enough, and this poor sick slave might have been carried on an ass or a camel, yet they inhumanely left him to perish
but, in the righteous providence of God, this cruelty was the occasion of their destruction
whilst David's kindness to a perishing stranger and slave was the means of his success, and proved the truest policy. Job 31:13-15
13.body:

27.heading: Bethel:
refs: Probably not the celebrated city of this name, but Bethul a city of Simeon - Josh 19:4
supposed to be the same as Bethelia, mentioned by Sozomen as belonging to Gaza, well peopled, and having several temples remarkable for their structure and antiquity
and which Jerome says, in his life of Hilarion, was five short days' journey from Pelusium. Gen 28:19
so called to distinguish it from Ramoth Gilead beyond Jordan. Josh 19:8 , Ramath
